models.note: Black manual carpet sweeper: small wheeled head with thin near-vertical stick handle and loop grip; 0.25 x 0.28 x 0.83 m; clean, very dark.

category_note: One clean, very dark sweeper standing upright on its small wheeled head with a thin 0.8 m handle. Plausible cleaning gear in homes, hotel and diner, but normally leans on a wall; the thin stick is a slight obstacle.
